statement: Exact Hausdorff gauges for SLE. Resolves Schramm’s Hausdorff-measure question for chordal SLEκ, $`0\lt \kappa\lt 8`$. The explicit gauge $`r^d(\log\log(1/r))^{(2-d)/2}`$, $`d=1+\kappa/8`$, gives almost surely positive finite measure to every trace segment $`\gamma([s,t])`$ with $`0\lt s\lt t\lt \infty`$, and finite expected measure to the trace in every bounded disk.
